item.title: Hegseth and Caine testify at Senate hearing amid Iran war
item.description: Watch live coverage as Defense Secretary Hegseth and Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Gen. Caine testify at a Senate Appropriations Committee hearing on the Department of Defense's budget request amid the Iran war and uncertainty around a possible peace deal as the cost of the conflict mounts.

item.title: How Americans see China now
item.description: As President Trump heads to China this week, a new NPR-Chicago Council-Ipsos poll finds most Americans think U.S. tariffs have hurt both economies, and that the Iran war is bad for America.

item.title: About 7 million kids live in a home with a loaded and unlocked gun, a study finds
item.description: The new study in JAMA Network Open also finds that more parents leave their guns loaded and unlocked when they have teenagers, despite the fact that suicide risk goes up for this age group.

item.title: Alabama splits U.S. House primaries after court ruling; SC redistricting stalls
item.description: Alabama will hold a special primary election for four of its seven congressional districts, after the Supreme Court cleared the way — as redistricting ripples through the south.
